discovery.english: Official Sonipat district revenue/Jamabandi pages, Haryana Web-HALRIS, HARSAC EODB GIS, and an ArcGIS administrative boundary service were found.
discovery.native: Hindi official Sonipat pages confirmed the Jamabandi route; no additional anonymous parcel API was exposed.

requestOutcomes: HARSAC frontend GET 200; current JavaScript/configuration revealed the /eodb_backend land-query route family.
Anonymous GET /land-query/districts and /land-query/search returned HTTP 401 Authentication required.
Anonymous POST /land-query/boundary-at-point at the exact WUP point returned HTTP 401 Authentication required.
Official Sonipat MC ArcGIS layer metadata returned HTTP 200, but it is an administrative boundary and not parcel geometry.
scopeLimits: No login, OTP, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA bypass, or unsafe owner/address/titleholder request was used.
A 401 response is treated as access limitation only; it is not evidence of no coverage.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe native parcel identity plus full parcel polygon was returned.
The municipal boundary layer does not qualify as a cadastral parcel source.

nativeFieldMapping.identityRule: No parcel identity was returned; do not substitute OBJECTID from the boundary layer or an internal row number.

qualification.serialReviewerAction: Independently qualify any future anonymous/public HARSAC parcel response before adapter admission.

serviceReview.uncertainty: The HARSAC cadastral backend is an official source candidate but its current anonymous access state and parcel response schema remain unverified.
